description: Part-load efficiency with flue gas enthalpy loss, auxiliary power curve, and stack temperature model for SC/USC Rankine cycle.

unit.name: Generic 800 MW Ultra-Supercritical PC Plant (700 C / 300 bar)
unit.source: Weitzel, P.S. (2011). ASME PVP-2011-57934; IEA CCC/168 (2010); Luo, Z. et al. (2013) Energy, 57, 236-244.

eta_iso.note: Net LHV efficiency at rated USC conditions (44-47%)

T_stack_rated_c.note: USC plants typically have tighter stack temperature control (advanced air preheaters)

T_stack_partload_offset_c.note: Stack temperature rise at minimum PLR

excess_air_fraction.note: USC uses lower excess air (15%) due to better burner control

aux_power_rated_pct.note: USC slightly lower aux power fraction due to fewer startup fans
